finalText:
The connection leak was in `processOrder.js` — it acquired a connection but didn't wrap the call in try/finally, so when `run()` threw an error (invalid order payloads), the connection was never released. Each failed job leaked one connection. Once the pool of 5 exhausted, everything timed out and the service crashed.

Fixed it by using the `withConnection` helper from `pool.js`, which already has the try/finally guarantee. All 4 tests pass now — including the one that specifically tests this scenario.
